requirement_summary: Security governance responsibilities should be defined
Information security roles and responsibilities should be established
Access should be managed according to risk and least privilege
Logical access should be restricted and monitored
Code changes should be reviewed before merge
Dependencies and code should be scanned for vulnerabilities
Security events should be logged and monitored
Personal data processing should be documented and controlled
AI systems should be documented and risk assessed
Authentication and authorization should be documented and reviewed
Input validation and secure error handling should be documented
Secrets management and abuse prevention should be reviewed
Cloud provider IAM and privileged access should be reviewed
Cloud encryption and backup controls should be reviewed
Roles agreements and data subject processes should be reviewed
AI vendor and transparency obligations should be reviewed
